[concept] marquee_seam_gap_antipattern (id=RecordId { table: Table("entity"), key: String("u648obzxum6631ihg2vd") }) {"description":"MISTAKE family hit repeatedly on the iwi-static carousel. Three recurring errors: (1) SEAM GAP — only 2 cloned copies + translateX(-50%); when a set is narrower than the viewport the loop reset shows empty space and the last card does not connect to the first. (2) DUAL WIDTH SOURCE — viewport width set in BOTH CSS (var(--row)) and an inline JS style.width='7*--sw'; the inline wins and fights CSS, so size never matches the intended reference. (3) SPEED-BY-COUNT — duration = n*constant ties speed to card count, so widening the card silently speeds the drift. (4) Non-responsive px sizing when responsive vmin/%/vh was required. FIX: measure real set width; copies=max(2,ceil((vw+set)/set)); one CSS source of truth (JS only measures); --dur=set/px-per-sec; clamp(rem, vmin, rem) sizing. tag anti_pattern.","display":"Anti-pattern: Marquee seam gap + dual width source","sources":["https://ryanmulligan.dev/blog/css-marquee/"],"tags":["anti_pattern","carousel","marquee","css","regression","ui"]}
